readings: Take fee records with `feerate` strictly greater than 0.0009 and join them to orders where `fees.orderslink` exactly matches `orders.recordvault`; discard unmatched fees. For each `orderslink` and `dealedge` combination, average the per-record value `feerate - rebrate`, excluding records whose net fee rate is missing. Count all matched fee records in the group, including those excluded from the average. For each side, take the unweighted average of its groups’ nonmissing average net fee rates. Show groups whose average net fee rate is strictly greater than that side average, with `orderslink`, side, group average net fee rate, record count, and group average minus side average. Sort by the difference descending, with missing values last; return the top 10 without rounding.

Take fee records with `feerate` strictly greater than 0.0009 and join them to orders where `fees.orderslink` exactly matches `orders.recordvault`; discard unmatched fees. For each `orderslink` and `dealedge` combination, average the per-record value `feerate - rebrate`, excluding records whose net fee rate is missing. Count only the matched fee records that contribute a nonmissing net fee rate to that average. For each side, take the unweighted average of its groups’ nonmissing average net fee rates. Show groups whose average net fee rate is strictly greater than that side average, with `orderslink`, side, group average net fee rate, record count, and group average minus side average. Sort by the difference descending, with missing values last; return the top 10 without rounding.
queries:
WITH fee_groups AS (
    SELECT
        f.orderslink,
        o.dealedge,
        AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
    WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge
),
side_averages AS (
    SELECT
        dealedge,
        AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS side_avg_net_fee_rate
    FROM fee_groups
    GROUP BY dealedge
)
SELECT
    g.orderslink,
    g.dealedge,
    g.avg_net_fee_rate,
    g.record_count,
    g.avg_net_fee_rate - s.side_avg_net_fee_rate AS difference
FROM fee_groups AS g
JOIN side_averages AS s
    ON g.dealedge = s.dealedge
WHERE g.avg_net_fee_rate > s.side_avg_net_fee_rate
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH group_rates AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink,
    o.dealedge AS side,
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
    AND f.rebrate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge
),
side_rates AS (
  SELECT side, AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS side_avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM group_rates
  GROUP BY side
)
SELECT
  g.orderslink,
  g.side,
  g.avg_net_fee_rate,
  g.record_count,
  g.avg_net_fee_rate - s.side_avg_net_fee_rate AS difference
FROM group_rates AS g
JOIN side_rates AS s ON g.side IS s.side
WHERE g.avg_net_fee_rate > s.side_avg_net_fee_rate
ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC
LIMIT 10
